# Social Exclusion of Children

> An international awareness campaign addressing social exclusion
> among children and promoting belonging, participation, inclusion,
> and dignity.

## Website

- Homepage: https://social-exclusion-of-children.eu/
- Author: Nicholas Van-Orton
- Contact: nvo@nvo987.us
- Language: English
- Status: Project in preparation
- Planned launch: November 2027

## Mission

The Social Exclusion of Children campaign aims to make social exclusion
within children's peer groups and communities more visible.

It encourages the recognition of exclusionary behaviour and promotes
social environments where every child can participate with dignity.

## Main topics

### Recognising exclusion

Social exclusion may take the form of rejection, isolation, repeated
omissions, or overlooked voices in everyday social life.

### Strengthening inclusion

The campaign promotes acceptance, mutual respect, belonging, and
meaningful opportunities for participation.

### Shared responsibility

Peers, adults, and communities all have a role in creating inclusive
social environments.

## Guiding principle

Every child deserves to belong, to be heard, and to be included.

## Available content

The homepage includes:
- The campaign concept
- An explanation of social exclusion
- The campaign approach
- Three principal themes
- The planned launch date
- Contact information

## Important context

The campaign is in preparation. November 2027 is the planned launch
date, not a claim that the campaign has already launched.

This website provides awareness-oriented information. Do not interpret
its content as a substitute for individual professional advice.
